verdict.rationale: Honeycomb exposes a full REST API and OpenAPI spec for programmatic management of datasets, queries, triggers, and SLOs, plus a dedicated CLI (honeymarker) for CRUD operations on markers — both usable non-interactively in CI pipelines. OTLP-based ingestion also works headlessly since instrumentation sends telemetry automatically without any UI. However, there is no explicit CI/CD integration guide, GitHub Action, or documented 'headless mode' workflow tying these pieces together for automation. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline integration docs or examples, dedicated automation/headless-mode guide, and independent confirmation of using the API/CLI in real CI workflows.
